stages.effectText: Can use a stronger [ note 1 ] Mobile Riot Shield that lasts for 55 seconds. The Mobile Riot Shield can only be deployed in the four tiles adjacent to Jessica the Liberated, and when deployed, Jessica the Liberated immediately turns to face the shield and increases the DEF of herself and units behind her by 15%

Can use an even stronger [ note 2 ] Mobile Riot Shield that lasts for 60 seconds. The Mobile Riot Shield can only be deployed in the four tiles adjacent to Jessica the Liberated, and when deployed, Jessica the Liberated immediately turns to face the shield and increases the DEF of herself and units behind her by 15%
When the Mobile Riot Shield takes damage, 55% chance to restore 1 SP to Jessica the Liberated and reduce the Mobile Riot Shield's Redeployment Time by -11 seconds
When the Mobile Riot Shield takes damage, 60% chance to restore 1 SP to Jessica the Liberated and reduce the Mobile Riot Shield's Redeployment Time by -14 seconds
